stories.title: Senate Republicans reelect Thune despite midterm rout
stories.description: Thune ran unopposed after colleagues, including Sens. Ron Johnson and Josh Hawley, failed to delay the vote over losing the majority.

stories.title: US indicts three in Iran-linked plot on RAF Fairford
stories.description: Prosecutors allege one defendant used coded calls from a Brooklyn federal jail to help direct the failed September attack on the base.

stories.title: US Army soldier arrested in UK over Russia spying claims
stories.description: Counter Terrorism Policing detained the 41-year-old near Gloucester under the National Security Act, working alongside the FBI and US military.

stories.title: Whistleblowers say Interior Dept destroying Trump construction project records
stories.description: Whistleblowers told House Democrats the Interior Department is destroying records tied to Trump's Washington construction projects, a claim Interior calls "100% false."

stories.title: Anthropic sets IPO range at $70-$78, eyes $1.4T value
stories.description: The Claude maker plans to sell 825 million shares, raising up to $64.4 billion in what could become the largest U.S. listing.

stories.title: Russia, Ukraine wrap first day of US-led Abu Dhabi talks
stories.description: Both sides sounded upbeat after the first trilateral meeting since February, but disputes over Donetsk and security guarantees remain unresolved.

stories.title: Hegseth calls GOP impeachment push a 'farce' ahead of vote
stories.description: Rep. Thomas Massie filed eight impeachment articles Monday over the Iran war and other actions; a House vote is expected Tuesday.

stories.title: October CPI tops forecasts, bolstering case for Fed hike
stories.description: Consumer prices rose 0.4% and core prices 0.3%, the level Fed Governor Waller said warrants considering a half-point hike in December.

stories.title: Russia hits Ukraine with 162 drones as Abu Dhabi talks open
stories.description: Ukraine's Air Force says it downed 135 drones. The strikes killed two people in Ladyzhyn and hit energy facilities in eight regions.

stories.title: US moves aircraft from RAF Mildenhall over Iran threat
stories.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Mildenhall is the second British base US aircraft have left over Iran concerns, after RAF Fairford.

stories.title: California voters reject Prop. 40 billionaire wealth tax
stories.description: The Associated Press called the race Monday after opponents, led by Sergey Brin, spent more than 10 times what supporters raised.

stories.title: DOJ probes Nvidia chip buyer Megaspeed, CBS reports
stories.description: The probe follows reports linking CEO Jensen Huang's admitted affair to Megaspeed's Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

stories.title: Senate advances permitting reform bill in 73-25 vote
stories.description: The chamber's first major action since the midterms opens debate on speeding energy project approvals. A final passage vote is scheduled for early next week.

stories.title: Trump says Iran war 'effectively over' after Qatar talks
stories.description: Trump signaled no plans to resume bombing for now, keeping the naval blockade and a new land operation, Iron Gate, in place.

stories.title: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for fridge hack
stories.description: Foreign Minister Barrot promised EU-level sanctions as Paris prosecutors opened an investigation into the leaders of the Iranian cyber unit Shahid Kaveh.

stories.title: Van Hollen opens door to challenging Schumer as leader
stories.description: A person close to the Maryland senator says he is in "active listening mode" after calls urging him to run in December's vote.

stories.title: US balks at China's scripted Trump-Xi-Putin summit plan
stories.description: Beijing wants each leader to read prepared statements at the proposed Shenzhen meeting, while Washington wants open talks, the Wall Street Journal reports.

stories.title: Commerce Dept. Megaspeed probe halted after Nvidia outreach, NYT reports
stories.description: The Megaspeed smuggling inquiry stopped after Nvidia's general counsel contacted investigators, then moved to the Justice Department, The New York Times reports.

stories.title: FDA orders eye risk warnings on Ozempic, Zepbound labels
stories.description: Drugmakers must add warnings about NAION, a rare condition linked to sudden vision loss, after months of lawsuits and FDA review.

stories.title: Supreme Court lets Trump resume Big Bend border wall
stories.description: Over Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson's dissent, justices lifted an injunction blocking construction across 300-plus miles, including Big Bend National Park.

stories.title: Zelenskyy says EU will rush emergency funds to Ukraine
stories.description: After a call with Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen, Zelenskyy said the money will target energy needs hit by Russian strikes.

stories.title: Saudi coalition downs Houthi missiles after Sanaa strikes
stories.description: The coalition said it intercepted missiles fired toward Riyadh on Sunday, a day after Houthi authorities said Saudi strikes killed 33 near Sanaa.

stories.title: Trump questions midterm results after vowing to accept them
stories.description: In a Truth Social post, Trump asked whether the vote that handed Democrats both chambers of Congress was honest, offering no evidence.

stories.title: Iraq says US asked it to shut most Iran border crossings
stories.description: Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said Baghdad hasn't agreed to the Treasury request and warned that closing crossings would hurt Iraq's economy.

stories.title: Herzog taps Netanyahu rival Eisenkot to form government
stories.description: The former military chief will formally receive the mandate Sunday evening, with 28 days to build a majority after an inconclusive election.

stories.title: Trump tells 60 Minutes deportation push was 'too tough'
stories.description: The admission, in an excerpt released before Sunday's broadcast, comes days after he named deportation architect Stephen Miller chief of staff.

stories.title: Lame-duck GOP Congress to return with 55 days left
stories.description: Republicans lost Congress Nov. 3 and must pass funding by Dec. 11 to avert a shutdown before Democrats take over Jan. 3.

stories.title: Araghchi says two-day Hormuz offer stands after midterms
stories.description: Iran's foreign minister told the White House to choose between meeting Tehran's conditions, including ending the US blockade, or war.

stories.title: Gunman kills six on Krakow's Main Market Square
stories.description: Police shot and detained the 25-year-old Polish suspect after he fired at random people from his car on Main Market Square.

stories.title: Blanche won't rule out probing Democrats over oversight
stories.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche said DOJ will defend Trump officials like Stephen Miller after Rep. Robert Garcia told them to "lawyer up."

stories.title: Two more DOJ officials quit as post-midterm exodus grows
stories.description: National Security Division head John Eisenberg and Miami U.S. Attorney Jason Reding Quiñones resigned Friday, a day after Harmeet Dhillon quit.

stories.title: Sen. Chris Murphy discharged after stroke, heads to rehab
stories.description: The Connecticut Democrat will spend several weeks at a rehabilitation center and miss Senate votes, including next week's post-election session.

stories.title: Trump says 'we're talking' to Iran as advisers clash
stories.description: U.S. officials told Axios that Trump will give diplomacy time after midterm losses Vance blamed on the war, though strikes remain ready.

stories.title: Vance weighs 2028 bid as donors balk after midterm rout
stories.description: Wealthy Republican donors are floating alternatives like Ron DeSantis, while rivals including Ted Cruz and Brian Kemp prepare possible challenges, reports say.

stories.title: Cornell Faculty Senate votes no confidence in leadership
stories.description: The 75-50 vote over the Jane Doe sexual assault case is largely symbolic. Trustees say they fully support President Kotlikoff.

stories.title: Trump weighs terror label to strip nonprofits' tax status
stories.description: The draft order, discussed for months but not finalized, would let the White House bypass the usual IRS process, the Journal reported.

stories.title: Hoax bomb threats force RTÉ to evacuate, disrupt newsrooms across Europe
stories.description: Emailed threats warning "the clock is ticking" hit broadcasters including Sky and Bulgaria's Nova TV; no bombs were found anywhere.

stories.title: US measles cases top 5,000, most since 1991, CDC says
stories.description: The count comes four days before the World Health Organization reviews, on Nov. 10, whether the U.S. keeps its measles elimination status.

stories.title: Europe rejects Trump push for wider Russia security deal
stories.description: EU foreign policy chief Kallas said Putin has no veto over European security, days before US-led Russia-Ukraine talks resume in Abu Dhabi.

stories.title: US adds 165,000 jobs in October; jobless rate dips to 4.1%
stories.description: Hiring far outpaced the roughly 65,000 economists expected in the first major data release since the midterms, though real wages keep slipping.

stories.title: Musk says Tesla to wind down Cybertruck by mid-2027
stories.description: The Texas factory space will go to Tesla's driverless Cybercab, Musk said, after the angular pickup fell far short of sales goals.

stories.title: Trump names Stephen Miller chief of staff, replacing Wiles
stories.description: Miller, architect of the immigration crackdown, starts Monday as Wiles shifts to Trump's political operation after Republicans lost both chambers of Congress.

stories.title: Democrats top 250 House seats in historic midterm wave
stories.description: CNN projects the party's largest House majority since 2008, with at least 54 Senate seats secured, as Mississippi and Alaska remain uncalled.

stories.title: Hoax bomb threats hit 27 European flights, jets scrambled
stories.description: French fighter jets escorted an Aer Lingus Dublin-Rome flight to a military base. No explosives were found in this week's second wave.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump's D.C. arch hours after final approval
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan's 14-day restraining order halts work on the 250-foot monument after a planning commission approved it 8-4.

stories.title: Studies tie vitamin K refusals to rise in infant bleeding
stories.description: Among 5.2 million US infants in a JAMA study, those missing the newborn shot had 47% higher bleeding risk; causation remains unproven.

stories.title: Tech stocks suffer worst day since April 2025 on AI fears
stories.description: Weak chip earnings and Democratic midterm gains that threaten AI data center construction pushed the Nasdaq Composite into correction territory.

stories.title: Democrats target Trump's Canada tariffs after midterm sweep
stories.description: Sen. Ron Wyden says talks on repeal legislation have begun, though analysts doubt Democrats can muster votes to override Trump's veto.

stories.title: DOJ takes Supreme Court abortion leak probe to grand jury
stories.description: Prosecutors led by Jeanine Pirro are seeking testimony from former court staff over the 2022 Dobbs draft leak, the Times reported.

stories.title: Over 600,000 protest across France over wages, living costs
stories.description: The CGT union says nearly 1.6 million marched as unions demanded higher pay and backed students, with clashes reported in Paris and Lyon.

stories.title: Trump meets Putin envoy Dmitriev, predicts 'very big' deal
stories.description: Trump wouldn't say what they discussed. He said a coming agreement would reach beyond Ukraine and "might involve all of Europe."

stories.title: Newsom moves to commute all 548 California death sentences
stories.description: The plan would empty California's death row, though the California Supreme Court must approve most commutations; the death penalty itself remains law.

stories.title: Karen Bass concedes as Nithya Raman wins LA mayor's race
stories.description: The democratic socialist councilmember becomes Los Angeles' first Asian American mayor-elect and the first challenger to unseat a sitting mayor since 2005.

stories.title: Trump moves to make Oval Office, Cabinet Room monuments
stories.description: The proclamation aims to protect his gilded redesign. Trump says he will send it to Congress, which Democrats will soon control, for ratification.

stories.title: Court files reveal US-Iran deportation talks during war
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes ordered advance notice of any removals after officials said they plan to deport Iranians through an unnamed third country.

stories.title: Nasdaq falls into correction on post-midterm AI fears
stories.description: Chipmakers and data center stocks led losses as investors worried Democrats' congressional wins will slow the AI infrastructure buildout, erasing Wednesday's rally.

stories.title: White House denies report Rubio may resign for 2028 run
stories.description: The Independent cited Republican sources saying the secretary of state may exit after Republicans lost both chambers of Congress in midterm elections.

stories.title: Russia agreed to supply Iran with 90 missile launchers
stories.description: Leaked documents describe an order for helicopter-mounted launchers that Russia uses widely in Ukraine. President Trump continues to play down Moscow's help to Tehran.

stories.title: Germany rejects von der Leyen's Canada 'associate' label
stories.description: Berlin restated its objection at a Wednesday meeting of EU ambassadors, while von der Leyen plans to keep the term, Politico reports.

stories.title: Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years for foreign collusion
stories.description: The democracy activist's second national security conviction comes as he was serving a subversion term and expected release in January.

stories.title: GOP allies urge Trump to change course after midterm rout
stories.description: Strategists want a White House shake-up and a retreat from the Iran war and tariffs after Democrats flipped both chambers of Congress.

stories.title: Hungary opens communist-era secret police files online
stories.description: The searchable database lists about 60,000 names; Prime Minister Péter Magyar says it fulfills a long-broken promise of the 1990 regime change.

stories.title: Iran shifts to guerrilla tactics, cutting Hormuz oil flows
stories.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed Wednesday four tankers hit mines, as Kpler estimates Hormuz oil flows dropped to roughly 45% of prewar levels.

stories.title: Israel faces $10B arms bill as Trump moves to end aid
stories.description: A State Department document says Israel needs $10 billion for outstanding US weapons orders beyond 2028, complicating Trump's plan to halt aid.

stories.title: Appeals court clears Mamdani's pied-à-terre tax rollout
stories.description: A unanimous Appellate Division panel reversed a Staten Island judge and ruled the homeowners lacked standing. The city must mail tax bills by Nov. 15.

stories.title: Iran hails US midterm results as Khamenei rejects thaw
stories.description: Speaker Ghalibaf said Americans voted "no to war," while Tehran stayed on high alert for new U.S. strikes after Democrats won Congress.

stories.title: Russian diesel tankers divert from US, clouding Trump deal
stories.description: Two of three cargoes promised under Trump's deal with Putin turned away as U.S. diesel supplies hit their lowest level since 2003.

stories.title: Drone strike sets fire to Ozon warehouse in southern Russia
stories.description: Ozon evacuated staff and pulled goods from sale after the second attack on its Adygeysk hub, part of Ukraine's campaign against retailers.

stories.title: Speaker Johnson won't run for minority leader after rout
stories.description: Democrats' House win opens an expected race between Steve Scalise and Jim Jordan, with GOP leadership elections set for Nov. 10.

stories.title: Alito tells allies he won't retire despite Democratic wins
stories.description: Democrats take control of the Senate Jan. 3, which leaves President Trump little time to confirm a new Supreme Court justice.

stories.title: Israel's Iran chemical arms warning splits US officials
stories.description: Some US officials see the intelligence as pressure from Netanyahu while Washington weighs renewed strikes against a Qatari-brokered deal.

stories.title: California voters reject Prop 39 voter ID measure
stories.description: The Republican-backed constitutional amendment would have required government-issued ID to vote in person and drew tens of millions from donors nationwide.

stories.title: Trump says he's not considering replacing Hegseth
stories.description: A day after Democrats won Congress amid Iran war frustration, Trump praised the Defense Secretary and floated him for Tennessee's Senate seat.

stories.title: FBI probes Perfect Child over $30,000-a-day autism bills
stories.description: Agents have contacted families billed hundreds of thousands of dollars by the Brooklyn provider, which allegedly promised little or no out-of-pocket costs.

stories.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan, set to be first Muslim senator
stories.description: Decision Desk HQ projected the Democrat's win early Wednesday, holding retiring Sen. Gary Peters' seat after a race marked by faith attacks.

stories.title: Jeffries vows bill to stop Trump tariffs, end Iran war
stories.description: Democrats won both chambers but lack the votes to override a Trump veto, and most tariffs rest on executive authority.

stories.title: Hoax bomb threats target seven flights across Europe
stories.description: Searches, a diversion and a temporary closure at Warsaw-Modlin followed threats against LOT, SAS, Wizz Air and Ryanair flights; nothing was found.

stories.title: Democrat Josh Turek flips Iowa Senate seat, beats Hinson
stories.description: The former Paralympian defeated Rep. Ashley Hinson for retiring Sen. Joni Ernst's seat, ending more than a decade of total GOP control of Iowa's Senate delegation.

stories.title: US allies see chastened Trump but fear midterm backlash
stories.description: Foreign leaders say Democrats' capture of Congress could curb Trump on Iran, but warn a weakened president may grow more unpredictable abroad.

stories.title: Supreme Court leans toward Catholic preschools' challenge
stories.description: Conservative justices seemed receptive Tuesday to Catholic schools shut out of Colorado's universal preschool program for refusing its LGBT nondiscrimination requirement.

stories.title: Hinojosa ousts Abbott to be Texas' first Latina governor
stories.description: Abbott conceded Tuesday night before networks called the race, ending more than three decades of Republican control of the office.

stories.title: Kim Yo Jong says North Korea has no need for US talks
stories.description: Her statement, followed hours later by a North Korean projectile launch, dims prospects for a Trump-Kim meeting at this month's Asia summits.

stories.title: Lavrov rejects EU ceasefire calls as bid to rearm Kyiv
stories.description: Speaking in Minsk, Russia's foreign minister dismissed partial energy, air and maritime truces, insisting the war's "underlying causes" be addressed first.

stories.title: Democrat Amy Acton defeats Ramaswamy in Ohio governor race
stories.description: The physician becomes the first woman elected Ohio governor and the first Democrat to win the office in 20 years, the AP reports.

stories.title: Trump says Canada deal near, fertilizer to be tariff-free
stories.description: Trump spoke on Election Day after a weekend call with Prime Minister Mark Carney, though neither government has announced terms or timeline.

stories.title: North Korea calls FBI Binance hack claim a provocation
stories.description: Kim Yo Jong, sister of leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the FBI's finding that Pyongyang stole more than $6 billion in crypto.

stories.title: Democrat Hamilton flips Kansas Senate seat, DDHQ projects
stories.description: The Methodist pastor unseated Republican Sen. Roger Marshall to become the first Democrat Kansas has elected to the U.S. Senate since 1932.

stories.title: US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Trump downplays war
stories.description: US officials describe the unannounced strikes near the Strait of Hormuz as defensive, coming on the eve of Tuesday's midterm elections.

stories.title: Karl Bushby ends 28-year world walk at mother's Hull home
stories.description: His mother greeted the 57-year-old former paratrooper with "Where have you been?" after a 31,000-mile trek that began in Chile in 1998.

stories.title: Democrat Annie Andrews flips South Carolina Senate seat
stories.description: The Charleston pediatrician defeated appointed Sen. Darline Graham and becomes the first woman South Carolina voters have elected to the Senate.

stories.title: Iran threatens US bases in Europe if Trump resumes strikes
stories.description: Tehran warned it could strike undersea cables and targets beyond the Middle East after Trump said he may give Iran "the hammer."

stories.title: Judge cites 'weaponization,' tosses ex-FBI officials' case
stories.description: Magistrate Judge Zia Faruqui found no probable cause that Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides lied to Congress about Hunter Biden probes.

stories.title: Ukraine, Russia alert apps hacked with fake nuclear alerts
stories.description: The breaches came overnight as the war's longest truce, around Oleshky in Kherson, ended; both governments said core warning systems kept working.

stories.title: Early exit polls show midterm voters souring on Trump
stories.description: About 6 in 10 midterm voters disapprove of Trump, and most blame his policies for high prices, the AP Voter Poll found.

stories.title: Khamenei grants Iran's government powers for US talks
stories.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian announced the move Monday, as oil prices fell on diplomacy hopes amid US and Israeli threats to resume war.

stories.title: Kherson truce ends as Russia rejects extension offer
stories.description: The war's longest ceasefire, which Melania Trump helped broker, allowed a rare evacuation of civilians from Russian-occupied Oleshky. A Ukrainian officer warns of worse fighting.

stories.title: Bottoms wins Georgia governor's race, flipping it blue
stories.description: The former Atlanta mayor defeated Republican Rick Jackson, NBC News projects, becoming Georgia's first Black and first woman governor-elect.

stories.title: Gulf states warn of fiercer war if US strikes Iran again
stories.description: UAE adviser Anwar Gargash said Gulf states are "braced for the worst" as Iranian negotiators met Qatari mediators for a third day.

stories.title: White House plans to bypass Congress if Democrats win
stories.description: Reuters reports aides have spent months drafting executive actions on tariffs and visas, while Trump says he may become "Mr. Veto."

stories.title: DOJ sends target letters to Democrats in Alaska probe
stories.description: Elections lawyer Marc Elias is among about 20 recipients, The New York Times reports, as Sen. Dan Sullivan faces Mary Peltola Tuesday.

stories.title: Russia detains minor over Moscow attack threat after US tip
stories.description: Russia's FSB security service thanked Washington after the US Embassy warned of a credible mass casualty threat at Moscow's Tsaritsyno park.

stories.title: Gen Z group plans new protests after Frankfurt looting
stories.description: Masked rioters looted shops late Saturday after mostly peaceful youth rallies in 34 German cities. Hesse officials blamed left-wing extremists for the violence.

stories.title: Boasberg rejects Democrats' bid to halt DOJ ballot push
stories.description: The judge found Democratic groups lacked standing, ruling hours before Tuesday's midterms, though he separately blocked federal demands targeting California ballots.

stories.title: Binance reopens withdrawals, says 95% of losses covered
stories.description: The exchange reopened Bitcoin withdrawals first on Sunday, following a record $6.3 billion heist that the FBI blamed on North Korea.

stories.title: Tusk vows no compromise in Constitutional Tribunal feud
stories.description: President Nawrocki calls the suspension of tribunal chief Swieczkowski a forcible takeover as protesters rally outside the Warsaw court again.

stories.title: Trump floats preemptive pardons for Musk, aides
stories.description: In a New York Post interview released a day before the midterms, Trump said he would protect allies if Democrats win Congress.

stories.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta talks without consensus
stories.description: Rubio cited growing interest in a limited Black Sea ceasefire, but rifts over Lavrov's attendance, Ukraine and Iran blocked a joint statement.

stories.title: Burnham open to slavery apology but rules out reparations
stories.description: Writing in the Guardian, the Prime Minister offered a "structured dialogue" before Commonwealth leaders meet in Antigua and Barbuda starting Sunday.

stories.title: Trump touts Reflecting Pool reopening in midterm pitch
stories.description: Speaking on the eve of Tuesday's elections, Trump joked about naming the troubled landmark after himself and repeated disputed vandalism claims.

stories.title: US prepares to deport over 150 Afghans via Pakistan
stories.description: The Louisiana charter could leave Monday; Pakistan is expected to send deportees on to Taliban-ruled Afghanistan, according to The New York Times.

stories.title: Pentagon told Baltics to mute Russia rhetoric, sources say
stories.description: Pentagon policy chief Elbridge Colby warned against "poking" Moscow, Reuters reports, while Estonia says no such requests reached it officially.

stories.title: Musk's $474M midterm giving sets donor record, NYT says
stories.description: On the eve of Tuesday's midterms, billionaires including Reid Hoffman and Diane Hendricks poured fresh millions into Wisconsin's governor race.

stories.title: Judge permanently tosses Trump's Wall Street Journal suit
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles ruled Trump failed to show actual malice in the Journal's Epstein birthday letter report, barring any refiling.

stories.title: Iran calls Vance letter 'positive' but rules out US meeting
stories.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Qatari and Pakistani mediators are still discussing Iran's conditions as fears grow of US strikes after midterms.

stories.title: Carney says Canada can wait out Trump on trade deal, eyes Europe
stories.description: Days before U.S. midterms, Carney told DW Ottawa will deepen ties with like-minded partners as stalled talks with Washington show little progress.

stories.title: Judge orders 3 taxpayer-funded Trump ads taken down
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Jennifer Rochon's order came days before the Nov. 3 midterms and covers an ad touting Trump's $5,000 promise.

stories.title: OpenAI cuts funding round target to $20 billion
stories.description: The ChatGPT maker's second scale-back in a week comes as an AI stock sell-off cools investor appetite, the Financial Times reported.

stories.title: ACA premiums to rise 13% in 2027, KFF analysis finds
stories.description: The second straight double-digit hike follows the expiration of enhanced tax credits, with open enrollment starting Sunday, two days before the midterms.

stories.title: Canada, EU set June 2027 target on associate membership
stories.description: A Montreal summit launched an Alliance for the Future, but the final declaration dropped the associate label after German and French objections.

stories.title: US approves allied-funded Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
stories.description: The State Department cleared 500 interceptors for Kyiv, funded by Canada, Germany, Norway and an EU loan, after Zelenskyy complained of delays.

stories.title: Judge probes whether DOJ misled court on Trump golf plan
stories.description: Judge Ana Reyes acted after Justice Department lawyers, who earlier denied closure plans, confirmed a Washington public course will close Nov. 15.

stories.title: Spain transport minister Puente refuses to resign over Urda train crash
stories.description: The Transport Minister said he offered his post to Sánchez, who called resignation "unjust," as calls to quit mount after deadly crash.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pope to vote in US election
stories.description: The Vatican said the Chicago-born pontiff mailed his ballot in Illinois ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms, without revealing his choices.

stories.title: Grand jury indicts ICE agent for running over Houston man
stories.description: Mario Alberto Morales faces aggravated assault charge after District Attorney Sean Teare said video shows him steering into a fleeing man.

stories.title: Trump erupted over his ex-lawyer’s $50M-plus deal with banker’s family, NYT reports
stories.description: Trump told aides his former lawyer should give part of the money to his future presidential library, the Times reported.

stories.title: Spain mourns as Urda train crash death toll rises to 74
stories.description: Transport Minister Óscar Puente called the order that let trains restart without speed limits after a computer failure "inexplicable."

stories.title: Alphabet has worst day ever as cash burn spooks investors
stories.description: Search revenue missed forecasts and free cash flow turned negative, while Alphabet said capital spending will rise significantly in 2027.

stories.title: Pentagon braces for budget $400B below Trump's ask
stories.description: Politico reports that officials privately consider the president's record $1.5 trillion defense request dead, and a $1.1 trillion plan is being drafted instead.

stories.title: Sir Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Picard, dies at 86
stories.description: The X-Men star died Wednesday at his Los Angeles home after battling Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia, his spokesperson said.

stories.title: Netanyahu bloc falls short of majority in final results
stories.description: Likud says Arab parties stole the vote, but Israeli police say they have found no evidence of widespread election fraud.

stories.title: CENTCOM chief briefs Trump on Iran strike options
stories.description: The rare White House meeting comes as Trump weighs a Tehran deal against renewed strikes, which he says won't precede midterms.

stories.title: China expels record 33 officials as Xi stresses discipline
stories.description: Former Central Military Commission vice chairman Zhang Youxia was among those ousted at a plenum that also had a record number of absent members.

stories.title: Trump officials promised Audi tariff relief, WSJ reports
stories.description: The offer came up in talks over Audi's roughly $4 billion Georgia plant, which Trump announced at a campaign rally in Perry on Saturday.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump limits on Medicaid frailty exemptions
stories.description: U.S. District Judge Richard Stearns sided with 25 states and D.C., but most work requirements still take effect Jan. 1.

stories.title: ECB holds rates at 2.5%, warns of rising inflation risks
stories.description: It came hours after Lagarde said she will step down early, with inflation at 3.8% and French borrowing costs rising.

stories.title: US economy grows 3.4% in third quarter, beating forecasts
stories.description: AI investment and strong consumer spending drove the advance estimate, the last major economic report before next week's midterm elections.

stories.title: Pentagon suspects hack in military base freezer failures
stories.description: Four officials told Reuters that investigators see possible sabotage behind August breakdowns that spoiled food at on-base grocery stores.

stories.title: Lagarde to step down early as ECB president on Feb. 7
stories.description: Her early exit lets EU leaders pick a successor before France's April presidential election, where eurosceptic candidates lead the polls.

stories.title: Democrats lead Texas, Michigan Senate races in CNN polls
stories.description: CNN also finds toss-ups in Maine and Kansas, five days before midterms in which Democrats need a net gain of four seats.

stories.title: Brewers beat Rays in Game 5 for first World Series title
stories.description: Jacob Misiorowski blanked Tampa Bay over 5 2/3 innings as Milwaukee won 4-1, capping an 11-2 postseason run.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico expand suit over press pool ban
stories.description: The filing alleges the White House still bars the outlets from Oval Office and Air Force One press pools over their coverage.

stories.title: Weil Gotshal to wind down after partner exodus
stories.description: Leaders told partners Wednesday the nearly century-old firm will dissolve after failed merger talks with Willkie Farr and a wave of departures.

stories.title: O'Keefe, Higby face felony voting charges in Minnesota
stories.description: Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty alleges the influencers gave election judges real voters' names during the Aug. 11 primary without casting ballots.

stories.title: Vance sends letter to Iran's Rezaei to revive peace talks
stories.description: The outreach to the Supreme National Security Council secretary, sent at Trump's direction, comes as Trump signals strikes could resume after midterms.

stories.title: HHS lets pharmacies make six unapproved peptides
stories.description: The policy skips formal rulemaking and covers compounds like BPC-157 promoted by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., despite objections from FDA scientists.

stories.title: Maduro trial judge Alvin Hellerstein dies at 92
stories.description: The Manhattan judge's cases, including Maduro's narco-terrorism prosecution, will be randomly reassigned to another judge, a court spokesperson said.

stories.title: Putin hails 'genius' Musk, cites satellite coordination
stories.description: Putin said Moscow works closely with Musk to avoid orbital interference, while admitting Russia's Starlink rival Rassvet is only taking first steps.

stories.title: US Navy warns ships to avoid nonessential Hormuz transits
stories.description: The advisory sets the threat level at severe and says neutral ships may be searched as Iranian attacks hit a wartime high.

stories.title: UFW co-founder Dolores Huerta dies at 96
stories.description: The farmworker organizer, who coined "Sí se puede," died of cancer at her Bakersfield home, according to a family representative.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami despite court travel ban
stories.description: The defeated presidential candidate fled via Argentina and Ecuador; the State Department says it will issue visas to him and his family.

top.title: Senate Republicans reelect Thune despite midterm rout
top.description: Thune ran unopposed after colleagues, including Sens. Ron Johnson and Josh Hawley, failed to delay the vote over losing the majority.

top.title: US indicts three in Iran-linked plot on RAF Fairford
top.description: Prosecutors allege one defendant used coded calls from a Brooklyn federal jail to help direct the failed September attack on the base.

top.title: US Army soldier arrested in UK over Russia spying claims
top.description: Counter Terrorism Policing detained the 41-year-old near Gloucester under the National Security Act, working alongside the FBI and US military.

top.title: Whistleblowers say Interior Dept destroying Trump construction project records
top.description: Whistleblowers told House Democrats the Interior Department is destroying records tied to Trump's Washington construction projects, a claim Interior calls "100% false."

top.title: Anthropic sets IPO range at $70-$78, eyes $1.4T value
top.description: The Claude maker plans to sell 825 million shares, raising up to $64.4 billion in what could become the largest U.S. listing.

top.title: Russia, Ukraine wrap first day of US-led Abu Dhabi talks
top.description: Both sides sounded upbeat after the first trilateral meeting since February, but disputes over Donetsk and security guarantees remain unresolved.

top.title: Hegseth calls GOP impeachment push a 'farce' ahead of vote
top.description: Rep. Thomas Massie filed eight impeachment articles Monday over the Iran war and other actions; a House vote is expected Tuesday.

top.title: October CPI tops forecasts, bolstering case for Fed hike
top.description: Consumer prices rose 0.4% and core prices 0.3%, the level Fed Governor Waller said warrants considering a half-point hike in December.

top.title: Russia hits Ukraine with 162 drones as Abu Dhabi talks open
top.description: Ukraine's Air Force says it downed 135 drones. The strikes killed two people in Ladyzhyn and hit energy facilities in eight regions.

top.title: US moves aircraft from RAF Mildenhall over Iran threat
top.description: The Wall Street Journal reports Mildenhall is the second British base US aircraft have left over Iran concerns, after RAF Fairford.

top.title: California voters reject Prop. 40 billionaire wealth tax
top.description: The Associated Press called the race Monday after opponents, led by Sergey Brin, spent more than 10 times what supporters raised.

top.title: DOJ probes Nvidia chip buyer Megaspeed, CBS reports
top.description: The probe follows reports linking CEO Jensen Huang's admitted affair to Megaspeed's Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

top.title: Senate advances permitting reform bill in 73-25 vote
top.description: The chamber's first major action since the midterms opens debate on speeding energy project approvals. A final passage vote is scheduled for early next week.

top.title: Trump says Iran war 'effectively over' after Qatar talks
top.description: Trump signaled no plans to resume bombing for now, keeping the naval blockade and a new land operation, Iron Gate, in place.

top.title: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for fridge hack
top.description: Foreign Minister Barrot promised EU-level sanctions as Paris prosecutors opened an investigation into the leaders of the Iranian cyber unit Shahid Kaveh.

top.title: Van Hollen opens door to challenging Schumer as leader
top.description: A person close to the Maryland senator says he is in "active listening mode" after calls urging him to run in December's vote.

top.title: US balks at China's scripted Trump-Xi-Putin summit plan
top.description: Beijing wants each leader to read prepared statements at the proposed Shenzhen meeting, while Washington wants open talks, the Wall Street Journal reports.

top.title: Commerce Dept. Megaspeed probe halted after Nvidia outreach, NYT reports
top.description: The Megaspeed smuggling inquiry stopped after Nvidia's general counsel contacted investigators, then moved to the Justice Department, The New York Times reports.

top.title: FDA orders eye risk warnings on Ozempic, Zepbound labels
top.description: Drugmakers must add warnings about NAION, a rare condition linked to sudden vision loss, after months of lawsuits and FDA review.

top.title: Supreme Court lets Trump resume Big Bend border wall
top.description: Over Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson's dissent, justices lifted an injunction blocking construction across 300-plus miles, including Big Bend National Park.

top.title: Zelenskyy says EU will rush emergency funds to Ukraine
top.description: After a call with Commission chief Ursula von der Leyen, Zelenskyy said the money will target energy needs hit by Russian strikes.

top.title: Saudi coalition downs Houthi missiles after Sanaa strikes
top.description: The coalition said it intercepted missiles fired toward Riyadh on Sunday, a day after Houthi authorities said Saudi strikes killed 33 near Sanaa.

top.title: Trump questions midterm results after vowing to accept them
top.description: In a Truth Social post, Trump asked whether the vote that handed Democrats both chambers of Congress was honest, offering no evidence.

top.title: Iraq says US asked it to shut most Iran border crossings
top.description: Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said Baghdad hasn't agreed to the Treasury request and warned that closing crossings would hurt Iraq's economy.

top.title: Herzog taps Netanyahu rival Eisenkot to form government
top.description: The former military chief will formally receive the mandate Sunday evening, with 28 days to build a majority after an inconclusive election.

top.title: Trump tells 60 Minutes deportation push was 'too tough'
top.description: The admission, in an excerpt released before Sunday's broadcast, comes days after he named deportation architect Stephen Miller chief of staff.

top.title: Lame-duck GOP Congress to return with 55 days left
top.description: Republicans lost Congress Nov. 3 and must pass funding by Dec. 11 to avert a shutdown before Democrats take over Jan. 3.

top.title: Araghchi says two-day Hormuz offer stands after midterms
top.description: Iran's foreign minister told the White House to choose between meeting Tehran's conditions, including ending the US blockade, or war.

top.title: Gunman kills six on Krakow's Main Market Square
top.description: Police shot and detained the 25-year-old Polish suspect after he fired at random people from his car on Main Market Square.

top.title: Blanche won't rule out probing Democrats over oversight
top.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche said DOJ will defend Trump officials like Stephen Miller after Rep. Robert Garcia told them to "lawyer up."

top.title: Two more DOJ officials quit as post-midterm exodus grows
top.description: National Security Division head John Eisenberg and Miami U.S. Attorney Jason Reding Quiñones resigned Friday, a day after Harmeet Dhillon quit.

top.title: Sen. Chris Murphy discharged after stroke, heads to rehab
top.description: The Connecticut Democrat will spend several weeks at a rehabilitation center and miss Senate votes, including next week's post-election session.

top.title: Trump says 'we're talking' to Iran as advisers clash
top.description: U.S. officials told Axios that Trump will give diplomacy time after midterm losses Vance blamed on the war, though strikes remain ready.

top.title: Vance weighs 2028 bid as donors balk after midterm rout
top.description: Wealthy Republican donors are floating alternatives like Ron DeSantis, while rivals including Ted Cruz and Brian Kemp prepare possible challenges, reports say.

top.title: Cornell Faculty Senate votes no confidence in leadership
top.description: The 75-50 vote over the Jane Doe sexual assault case is largely symbolic. Trustees say they fully support President Kotlikoff.

top.title: Trump weighs terror label to strip nonprofits' tax status
top.description: The draft order, discussed for months but not finalized, would let the White House bypass the usual IRS process, the Journal reported.

top.title: Hoax bomb threats force RTÉ to evacuate, disrupt newsrooms across Europe
top.description: Emailed threats warning "the clock is ticking" hit broadcasters including Sky and Bulgaria's Nova TV; no bombs were found anywhere.

top.title: US measles cases top 5,000, most since 1991, CDC says
top.description: The count comes four days before the World Health Organization reviews, on Nov. 10, whether the U.S. keeps its measles elimination status.

top.title: Europe rejects Trump push for wider Russia security deal
top.description: EU foreign policy chief Kallas said Putin has no veto over European security, days before US-led Russia-Ukraine talks resume in Abu Dhabi.

top.title: US adds 165,000 jobs in October; jobless rate dips to 4.1%
top.description: Hiring far outpaced the roughly 65,000 economists expected in the first major data release since the midterms, though real wages keep slipping.

top.title: Musk says Tesla to wind down Cybertruck by mid-2027
top.description: The Texas factory space will go to Tesla's driverless Cybercab, Musk said, after the angular pickup fell far short of sales goals.

top.title: Trump names Stephen Miller chief of staff, replacing Wiles
top.description: Miller, architect of the immigration crackdown, starts Monday as Wiles shifts to Trump's political operation after Republicans lost both chambers of Congress.

top.title: Democrats top 250 House seats in historic midterm wave
top.description: CNN projects the party's largest House majority since 2008, with at least 54 Senate seats secured, as Mississippi and Alaska remain uncalled.

top.title: Hoax bomb threats hit 27 European flights, jets scrambled
top.description: French fighter jets escorted an Aer Lingus Dublin-Rome flight to a military base. No explosives were found in this week's second wave.

top.title: Judge blocks Trump's D.C. arch hours after final approval
top.description: U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan's 14-day restraining order halts work on the 250-foot monument after a planning commission approved it 8-4.

top.title: Studies tie vitamin K refusals to rise in infant bleeding
top.description: Among 5.2 million US infants in a JAMA study, those missing the newborn shot had 47% higher bleeding risk; causation remains unproven.

top.title: Tech stocks suffer worst day since April 2025 on AI fears
top.description: Weak chip earnings and Democratic midterm gains that threaten AI data center construction pushed the Nasdaq Composite into correction territory.

top.title: Democrats target Trump's Canada tariffs after midterm sweep
top.description: Sen. Ron Wyden says talks on repeal legislation have begun, though analysts doubt Democrats can muster votes to override Trump's veto.

top.title: DOJ takes Supreme Court abortion leak probe to grand jury
top.description: Prosecutors led by Jeanine Pirro are seeking testimony from former court staff over the 2022 Dobbs draft leak, the Times reported.

top.title: Over 600,000 protest across France over wages, living costs
top.description: The CGT union says nearly 1.6 million marched as unions demanded higher pay and backed students, with clashes reported in Paris and Lyon.

top.title: Trump meets Putin envoy Dmitriev, predicts 'very big' deal
top.description: Trump wouldn't say what they discussed. He said a coming agreement would reach beyond Ukraine and "might involve all of Europe."

top.title: Newsom moves to commute all 548 California death sentences
top.description: The plan would empty California's death row, though the California Supreme Court must approve most commutations; the death penalty itself remains law.

top.title: Karen Bass concedes as Nithya Raman wins LA mayor's race
top.description: The democratic socialist councilmember becomes Los Angeles' first Asian American mayor-elect and the first challenger to unseat a sitting mayor since 2005.

top.title: Trump moves to make Oval Office, Cabinet Room monuments
top.description: The proclamation aims to protect his gilded redesign. Trump says he will send it to Congress, which Democrats will soon control, for ratification.

top.title: Court files reveal US-Iran deportation talks during war
top.description: U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes ordered advance notice of any removals after officials said they plan to deport Iranians through an unnamed third country.

top.title: Nasdaq falls into correction on post-midterm AI fears
top.description: Chipmakers and data center stocks led losses as investors worried Democrats' congressional wins will slow the AI infrastructure buildout, erasing Wednesday's rally.

top.title: White House denies report Rubio may resign for 2028 run
top.description: The Independent cited Republican sources saying the secretary of state may exit after Republicans lost both chambers of Congress in midterm elections.

top.title: Russia agreed to supply Iran with 90 missile launchers
top.description: Leaked documents describe an order for helicopter-mounted launchers that Russia uses widely in Ukraine. President Trump continues to play down Moscow's help to Tehran.

top.title: Germany rejects von der Leyen's Canada 'associate' label
top.description: Berlin restated its objection at a Wednesday meeting of EU ambassadors, while von der Leyen plans to keep the term, Politico reports.

top.title: Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years for foreign collusion
top.description: The democracy activist's second national security conviction comes as he was serving a subversion term and expected release in January.

top.title: GOP allies urge Trump to change course after midterm rout
top.description: Strategists want a White House shake-up and a retreat from the Iran war and tariffs after Democrats flipped both chambers of Congress.

top.title: Hungary opens communist-era secret police files online
top.description: The searchable database lists about 60,000 names; Prime Minister Péter Magyar says it fulfills a long-broken promise of the 1990 regime change.

top.title: Iran shifts to guerrilla tactics, cutting Hormuz oil flows
top.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed Wednesday four tankers hit mines, as Kpler estimates Hormuz oil flows dropped to roughly 45% of prewar levels.

top.title: Israel faces $10B arms bill as Trump moves to end aid
top.description: A State Department document says Israel needs $10 billion for outstanding US weapons orders beyond 2028, complicating Trump's plan to halt aid.

top.title: Appeals court clears Mamdani's pied-à-terre tax rollout
top.description: A unanimous Appellate Division panel reversed a Staten Island judge and ruled the homeowners lacked standing. The city must mail tax bills by Nov. 15.

top.title: Iran hails US midterm results as Khamenei rejects thaw
top.description: Speaker Ghalibaf said Americans voted "no to war," while Tehran stayed on high alert for new U.S. strikes after Democrats won Congress.

top.title: Russian diesel tankers divert from US, clouding Trump deal
top.description: Two of three cargoes promised under Trump's deal with Putin turned away as U.S. diesel supplies hit their lowest level since 2003.

top.title: Drone strike sets fire to Ozon warehouse in southern Russia
top.description: Ozon evacuated staff and pulled goods from sale after the second attack on its Adygeysk hub, part of Ukraine's campaign against retailers.

top.title: Speaker Johnson won't run for minority leader after rout
top.description: Democrats' House win opens an expected race between Steve Scalise and Jim Jordan, with GOP leadership elections set for Nov. 10.

top.title: Alito tells allies he won't retire despite Democratic wins
top.description: Democrats take control of the Senate Jan. 3, which leaves President Trump little time to confirm a new Supreme Court justice.

top.title: Israel's Iran chemical arms warning splits US officials
top.description: Some US officials see the intelligence as pressure from Netanyahu while Washington weighs renewed strikes against a Qatari-brokered deal.

top.title: California voters reject Prop 39 voter ID measure
top.description: The Republican-backed constitutional amendment would have required government-issued ID to vote in person and drew tens of millions from donors nationwide.

top.title: Trump says he's not considering replacing Hegseth
top.description: A day after Democrats won Congress amid Iran war frustration, Trump praised the Defense Secretary and floated him for Tennessee's Senate seat.

top.title: FBI probes Perfect Child over $30,000-a-day autism bills
top.description: Agents have contacted families billed hundreds of thousands of dollars by the Brooklyn provider, which allegedly promised little or no out-of-pocket costs.

top.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan, set to be first Muslim senator
top.description: Decision Desk HQ projected the Democrat's win early Wednesday, holding retiring Sen. Gary Peters' seat after a race marked by faith attacks.

top.title: Jeffries vows bill to stop Trump tariffs, end Iran war
top.description: Democrats won both chambers but lack the votes to override a Trump veto, and most tariffs rest on executive authority.

top.title: Hoax bomb threats target seven flights across Europe
top.description: Searches, a diversion and a temporary closure at Warsaw-Modlin followed threats against LOT, SAS, Wizz Air and Ryanair flights; nothing was found.

top.title: Democrat Josh Turek flips Iowa Senate seat, beats Hinson
top.description: The former Paralympian defeated Rep. Ashley Hinson for retiring Sen. Joni Ernst's seat, ending more than a decade of total GOP control of Iowa's Senate delegation.

top.title: US allies see chastened Trump but fear midterm backlash
top.description: Foreign leaders say Democrats' capture of Congress could curb Trump on Iran, but warn a weakened president may grow more unpredictable abroad.

top.title: Supreme Court leans toward Catholic preschools' challenge
top.description: Conservative justices seemed receptive Tuesday to Catholic schools shut out of Colorado's universal preschool program for refusing its LGBT nondiscrimination requirement.

top.title: Hinojosa ousts Abbott to be Texas' first Latina governor
top.description: Abbott conceded Tuesday night before networks called the race, ending more than three decades of Republican control of the office.

top.title: Kim Yo Jong says North Korea has no need for US talks
top.description: Her statement, followed hours later by a North Korean projectile launch, dims prospects for a Trump-Kim meeting at this month's Asia summits.

top.title: Lavrov rejects EU ceasefire calls as bid to rearm Kyiv
top.description: Speaking in Minsk, Russia's foreign minister dismissed partial energy, air and maritime truces, insisting the war's "underlying causes" be addressed first.

top.title: Democrat Amy Acton defeats Ramaswamy in Ohio governor race
top.description: The physician becomes the first woman elected Ohio governor and the first Democrat to win the office in 20 years, the AP reports.

top.title: Trump says Canada deal near, fertilizer to be tariff-free
top.description: Trump spoke on Election Day after a weekend call with Prime Minister Mark Carney, though neither government has announced terms or timeline.

top.title: North Korea calls FBI Binance hack claim a provocation
top.description: Kim Yo Jong, sister of leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed the FBI's finding that Pyongyang stole more than $6 billion in crypto.

top.title: Democrat Hamilton flips Kansas Senate seat, DDHQ projects
top.description: The Methodist pastor unseated Republican Sen. Roger Marshall to become the first Democrat Kansas has elected to the U.S. Senate since 1932.

top.title: US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Trump downplays war
top.description: US officials describe the unannounced strikes near the Strait of Hormuz as defensive, coming on the eve of Tuesday's midterm elections.

top.title: Karl Bushby ends 28-year world walk at mother's Hull home
top.description: His mother greeted the 57-year-old former paratrooper with "Where have you been?" after a 31,000-mile trek that began in Chile in 1998.

top.title: Democrat Annie Andrews flips South Carolina Senate seat
top.description: The Charleston pediatrician defeated appointed Sen. Darline Graham and becomes the first woman South Carolina voters have elected to the Senate.

top.title: Iran threatens US bases in Europe if Trump resumes strikes
top.description: Tehran warned it could strike undersea cables and targets beyond the Middle East after Trump said he may give Iran "the hammer."

top.title: Judge cites 'weaponization,' tosses ex-FBI officials' case
top.description: Magistrate Judge Zia Faruqui found no probable cause that Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides lied to Congress about Hunter Biden probes.

top.title: Ukraine, Russia alert apps hacked with fake nuclear alerts
top.description: The breaches came overnight as the war's longest truce, around Oleshky in Kherson, ended; both governments said core warning systems kept working.

top.title: Early exit polls show midterm voters souring on Trump
top.description: About 6 in 10 midterm voters disapprove of Trump, and most blame his policies for high prices, the AP Voter Poll found.

top.title: Khamenei grants Iran's government powers for US talks
top.description: President Masoud Pezeshkian announced the move Monday, as oil prices fell on diplomacy hopes amid US and Israeli threats to resume war.

top.title: Kherson truce ends as Russia rejects extension offer
top.description: The war's longest ceasefire, which Melania Trump helped broker, allowed a rare evacuation of civilians from Russian-occupied Oleshky. A Ukrainian officer warns of worse fighting.

top.title: Bottoms wins Georgia governor's race, flipping it blue
top.description: The former Atlanta mayor defeated Republican Rick Jackson, NBC News projects, becoming Georgia's first Black and first woman governor-elect.

top.title: Gulf states warn of fiercer war if US strikes Iran again
top.description: UAE adviser Anwar Gargash said Gulf states are "braced for the worst" as Iranian negotiators met Qatari mediators for a third day.

top.title: White House plans to bypass Congress if Democrats win
top.description: Reuters reports aides have spent months drafting executive actions on tariffs and visas, while Trump says he may become "Mr. Veto."

top.title: DOJ sends target letters to Democrats in Alaska probe
top.description: Elections lawyer Marc Elias is among about 20 recipients, The New York Times reports, as Sen. Dan Sullivan faces Mary Peltola Tuesday.

top.title: Russia detains minor over Moscow attack threat after US tip
top.description: Russia's FSB security service thanked Washington after the US Embassy warned of a credible mass casualty threat at Moscow's Tsaritsyno park.

top.title: Gen Z group plans new protests after Frankfurt looting
top.description: Masked rioters looted shops late Saturday after mostly peaceful youth rallies in 34 German cities. Hesse officials blamed left-wing extremists for the violence.

top.title: Boasberg rejects Democrats' bid to halt DOJ ballot push
top.description: The judge found Democratic groups lacked standing, ruling hours before Tuesday's midterms, though he separately blocked federal demands targeting California ballots.

top.title: Binance reopens withdrawals, says 95% of losses covered
top.description: The exchange reopened Bitcoin withdrawals first on Sunday, following a record $6.3 billion heist that the FBI blamed on North Korea.

top.title: Tusk vows no compromise in Constitutional Tribunal feud
top.description: President Nawrocki calls the suspension of tribunal chief Swieczkowski a forcible takeover as protesters rally outside the Warsaw court again.

top.title: Trump floats preemptive pardons for Musk, aides
top.description: In a New York Post interview released a day before the midterms, Trump said he would protect allies if Democrats win Congress.

top.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta talks without consensus
top.description: Rubio cited growing interest in a limited Black Sea ceasefire, but rifts over Lavrov's attendance, Ukraine and Iran blocked a joint statement.

top.title: Burnham open to slavery apology but rules out reparations
top.description: Writing in the Guardian, the Prime Minister offered a "structured dialogue" before Commonwealth leaders meet in Antigua and Barbuda starting Sunday.

top.title: Trump touts Reflecting Pool reopening in midterm pitch
top.description: Speaking on the eve of Tuesday's elections, Trump joked about naming the troubled landmark after himself and repeated disputed vandalism claims.

top.title: US prepares to deport over 150 Afghans via Pakistan
top.description: The Louisiana charter could leave Monday; Pakistan is expected to send deportees on to Taliban-ruled Afghanistan, according to The New York Times.

top.title: Pentagon told Baltics to mute Russia rhetoric, sources say
top.description: Pentagon policy chief Elbridge Colby warned against "poking" Moscow, Reuters reports, while Estonia says no such requests reached it officially.

top.title: Musk's $474M midterm giving sets donor record, NYT says
top.description: On the eve of Tuesday's midterms, billionaires including Reid Hoffman and Diane Hendricks poured fresh millions into Wisconsin's governor race.

top.title: Judge permanently tosses Trump's Wall Street Journal suit
top.description: U.S. District Judge Darrin Gayles ruled Trump failed to show actual malice in the Journal's Epstein birthday letter report, barring any refiling.

top.title: Iran calls Vance letter 'positive' but rules out US meeting
top.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Qatari and Pakistani mediators are still discussing Iran's conditions as fears grow of US strikes after midterms.

top.title: Carney says Canada can wait out Trump on trade deal, eyes Europe
top.description: Days before U.S. midterms, Carney told DW Ottawa will deepen ties with like-minded partners as stalled talks with Washington show little progress.

top.title: Judge orders 3 taxpayer-funded Trump ads taken down
top.description: U.S. District Judge Jennifer Rochon's order came days before the Nov. 3 midterms and covers an ad touting Trump's $5,000 promise.

top.title: OpenAI cuts funding round target to $20 billion
top.description: The ChatGPT maker's second scale-back in a week comes as an AI stock sell-off cools investor appetite, the Financial Times reported.

top.title: ACA premiums to rise 13% in 2027, KFF analysis finds
top.description: The second straight double-digit hike follows the expiration of enhanced tax credits, with open enrollment starting Sunday, two days before the midterms.

top.title: Canada, EU set June 2027 target on associate membership
top.description: A Montreal summit launched an Alliance for the Future, but the final declaration dropped the associate label after German and French objections.

top.title: US approves allied-funded Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
top.description: The State Department cleared 500 interceptors for Kyiv, funded by Canada, Germany, Norway and an EU loan, after Zelenskyy complained of delays.

top.title: Judge probes whether DOJ misled court on Trump golf plan
top.description: Judge Ana Reyes acted after Justice Department lawyers, who earlier denied closure plans, confirmed a Washington public course will close Nov. 15.

top.title: Spain transport minister Puente refuses to resign over Urda train crash
top.description: The Transport Minister said he offered his post to Sánchez, who called resignation "unjust," as calls to quit mount after deadly crash.

top.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pope to vote in US election
top.description: The Vatican said the Chicago-born pontiff mailed his ballot in Illinois ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms, without revealing his choices.

top.title: Grand jury indicts ICE agent for running over Houston man
top.description: Mario Alberto Morales faces aggravated assault charge after District Attorney Sean Teare said video shows him steering into a fleeing man.

top.title: Trump erupted over his ex-lawyer’s $50M-plus deal with banker’s family, NYT reports
top.description: Trump told aides his former lawyer should give part of the money to his future presidential library, the Times reported.

top.title: Spain mourns as Urda train crash death toll rises to 74
top.description: Transport Minister Óscar Puente called the order that let trains restart without speed limits after a computer failure "inexplicable."

top.title: Alphabet has worst day ever as cash burn spooks investors
top.description: Search revenue missed forecasts and free cash flow turned negative, while Alphabet said capital spending will rise significantly in 2027.

top.title: Pentagon braces for budget $400B below Trump's ask
top.description: Politico reports that officials privately consider the president's record $1.5 trillion defense request dead, and a $1.1 trillion plan is being drafted instead.

top.title: Sir Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Picard, dies at 86
top.description: The X-Men star died Wednesday at his Los Angeles home after battling Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia, his spokesperson said.

top.title: Netanyahu bloc falls short of majority in final results
top.description: Likud says Arab parties stole the vote, but Israeli police say they have found no evidence of widespread election fraud.

top.title: CENTCOM chief briefs Trump on Iran strike options
top.description: The rare White House meeting comes as Trump weighs a Tehran deal against renewed strikes, which he says won't precede midterms.

top.title: China expels record 33 officials as Xi stresses discipline
top.description: Former Central Military Commission vice chairman Zhang Youxia was among those ousted at a plenum that also had a record number of absent members.

top.title: Trump officials promised Audi tariff relief, WSJ reports
top.description: The offer came up in talks over Audi's roughly $4 billion Georgia plant, which Trump announced at a campaign rally in Perry on Saturday.

top.title: Judge blocks Trump limits on Medicaid frailty exemptions
top.description: U.S. District Judge Richard Stearns sided with 25 states and D.C., but most work requirements still take effect Jan. 1.

top.title: ECB holds rates at 2.5%, warns of rising inflation risks
top.description: It came hours after Lagarde said she will step down early, with inflation at 3.8% and French borrowing costs rising.

top.title: US economy grows 3.4% in third quarter, beating forecasts
top.description: AI investment and strong consumer spending drove the advance estimate, the last major economic report before next week's midterm elections.

top.title: Pentagon suspects hack in military base freezer failures
top.description: Four officials told Reuters that investigators see possible sabotage behind August breakdowns that spoiled food at on-base grocery stores.

top.title: Lagarde to step down early as ECB president on Feb. 7
top.description: Her early exit lets EU leaders pick a successor before France's April presidential election, where eurosceptic candidates lead the polls.

top.title: Democrats lead Texas, Michigan Senate races in CNN polls
top.description: CNN also finds toss-ups in Maine and Kansas, five days before midterms in which Democrats need a net gain of four seats.

top.title: Brewers beat Rays in Game 5 for first World Series title
top.description: Jacob Misiorowski blanked Tampa Bay over 5 2/3 innings as Milwaukee won 4-1, capping an 11-2 postseason run.

top.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico expand suit over press pool ban
top.description: The filing alleges the White House still bars the outlets from Oval Office and Air Force One press pools over their coverage.

top.title: Weil Gotshal to wind down after partner exodus
top.description: Leaders told partners Wednesday the nearly century-old firm will dissolve after failed merger talks with Willkie Farr and a wave of departures.

top.title: O'Keefe, Higby face felony voting charges in Minnesota
top.description: Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty alleges the influencers gave election judges real voters' names during the Aug. 11 primary without casting ballots.

top.title: Vance sends letter to Iran's Rezaei to revive peace talks
top.description: The outreach to the Supreme National Security Council secretary, sent at Trump's direction, comes as Trump signals strikes could resume after midterms.

top.title: HHS lets pharmacies make six unapproved peptides
top.description: The policy skips formal rulemaking and covers compounds like BPC-157 promoted by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., despite objections from FDA scientists.

top.title: Maduro trial judge Alvin Hellerstein dies at 92
top.description: The Manhattan judge's cases, including Maduro's narco-terrorism prosecution, will be randomly reassigned to another judge, a court spokesperson said.

top.title: Putin hails 'genius' Musk, cites satellite coordination
top.description: Putin said Moscow works closely with Musk to avoid orbital interference, while admitting Russia's Starlink rival Rassvet is only taking first steps.

top.title: US Navy warns ships to avoid nonessential Hormuz transits
top.description: The advisory sets the threat level at severe and says neutral ships may be searched as Iranian attacks hit a wartime high.

top.title: UFW co-founder Dolores Huerta dies at 96
top.description: The farmworker organizer, who coined "Sí se puede," died of cancer at her Bakersfield home, according to a family representative.

top.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami despite court travel ban
top.description: The defeated presidential candidate fled via Argentina and Ecuador; the State Department says it will issue visas to him and his family.
